- Confirmed the concrete boundary candidate: tests/ha/support/runner/mod.rs was a pure pass-through Tokio bootstrap wrapper and has been collapsed into tests/ha/support/mod.rs with tests/ha.rs calling support::run_feature directly.
- Verified there are no remaining references to support::runner or run_feature_test anywhere in tests/src.
- Checked the previously logged HarnessRuntime fallout in tests/ha/support/world/mod.rs; the current tree no longer constructs that removed wrapper shape, so the remaining task is verification and any fallout fixes.

- Ran make check and it passed cleanly after the runner-boundary collapse.
- Confirmed nextest config excludes ha scenario tests from the default profile, so verification must include an explicit focused ha run.
- Started a focused cargo nextest run for the exact ha scenario ha_replica_faults_keep_cluster_healthy::stopped_replica under profile ultra-long to exercise the new support::run_feature entrypoint.

- Verification succeeded: make check passed, and the focused HA scenario ha_replica_faults_keep_cluster_healthy::stopped_replica passed through the direct support::run_feature entrypoint.
- No remaining references to the deleted runner wrapper exist, so the smell-1 pass-through boundary has been fully collapsed for tests/ha/support.
- Next step is to stage only tests/ha.rs and tests/ha/support changes, commit them without scooping unrelated worktree changes, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
